rebuild: Link-only documents are not redistributed. Run `gapcourt kb-fetch` to download each raw file from its official address and check its sha256 (entries marked manual need a browser step), then `gapcourt prepare --rebuild-all` to write the corpus files from the raw files with the recorded transforms, then `gapcourt build-kb`. kb_version matches the published one only when every document is rebuilt byte for byte; documents that `gapcourt prepare` reports as AUDITED are curated excerpts that pass a verbatim audit but have no byte-exact transform (see docs/CORPUS_PROVENANCE.md).
